title: How different is rational approximation from piecewise polynomial approximation?
summary: The first aim of this paper is to show that there is merit to the question posed in the title. Indeed, for certain function classes, approximation by rational functions and by piecewise polynomials are surprisingly similar. Between these two, polynomials are more widely studied and more widely used. One setting in which both approaches are equally well understood, and equally practical in use, is that of approximating univariate functions with point singularities.
